card.title: Chat sync · end-to-end encrypted
card.subtitle: Your conversations are encrypted in this browser with a key that only your passphrase opens. The server stores ciphertext only. Provider keys, signing keys and turns that stayed on this device are never synced.

form.new_hint: Choose a passphrase of at least {n} characters. You need it to restore your conversations in another browser. Nobody can recover it for you, and without it the synced copy cannot be read.
form.join_hint: This account already syncs from another browser. Enter the passphrase you chose there to bring its conversations here.
form.connection: Sync needs a connection to the knowledge base with a session (Settings › Knowledge base).

on.skipped: {n} conversations are not synced: too large, or not readable with this key.
on.off_delete: Turn off and delete synced data
on.off_local_confirm: Turn sync off in this browser? Its conversations stay here, the synced copy stays on the server for your other browsers.
on.off_delete_confirm: Turn sync off and delete the synced copy of your conversations from the server? Every browser keeps the conversations it has, but stops syncing. This cannot be undone.

notice.remote_off: Sync was turned off in another browser and the synced copy was deleted. The conversations in this browser are kept. Choose a passphrase to sync again, or turn sync off here.
notice.rekeyed: Sync was set up again in another browser with a new passphrase. Enter that passphrase to continue.
notice.other_account: This browser is signed in to another account than the one it synced with. Turn sync off here, then turn it on for this account.
notice.unavailable: This browser cannot keep the sync key for this site (for example in a private window, or with site data turned off).

account.title: Use sync in another browser
account.body: Another browser needs the same account. Add an email address to this browser's account, sign in with that address in the other browser, then enter your passphrase there.
account.anonymous: This browser: anonymous account (this browser only)
account.sign_in_hint: Signing in replaces this browser's anonymous account; documents you added from it stay with that account.

line.waiting: End-to-end encrypted · waiting for a connection

result.enabled: Sync is on. Your conversations are encrypted and synced.
result.joined: Unlocked. The conversations of this account are synced into this browser.
result.off: Sync is off in this browser.
result.deleted: Sync is off and the synced copy was deleted.
result.code_sent: We sent a code to {email}. Enter it below.
result.linked: The email address is added to this account.
result.signed_in: Signed in. Enter your passphrase to sync.
result.signed_out: Signed out. This browser has a new anonymous account.

error.too_short: The passphrase needs at least {n} characters.
error.wrong_passphrase: That passphrase does not unlock the synced conversations of this account.
error.no_session: There is no session with the knowledge base. Sync needs one.
error.offline: The knowledge base cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
error.missing_schema: The database has no sync tables yet (migration chat_sync in backend/supabase).
error.unavailable: This browser cannot keep the sync key.
error.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
error.delete_failed: The synced copy could not be deleted right now. Sync stays on; try again later.
error.invalid_code: That code is wrong or has expired.
error.email_taken: This address belongs to another account. Use "Sign in to my account" instead.
error.no_account: No account has this address, or email sign-in is off for this site.
error.email_disabled: Email sign-in is turned off for this site.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
